description:
Object Analysis - Renewed

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
The Objects Analysis ability from Harpuea's Objects Analysis, without its frame rate cost.

The Ability
Hover Objects Analysis on your ability bar to list the objects in the current star system: derelicts, caches, abandoned stations, gates and other things worth finding. Colony stations and clutter are left out, repeats are grouped, found objects are gray.
It does not say where they are.
Click it to scan: the fleet stops for about 5 seconds, then every object in the system is discovered and named on the map, and every planet gets a preliminary survey. Costs 5 volatiles by default.
Works only inside star systems.

Settings (LunaLib, optional)
Detail: Precise (default) shows derelict ships by name and class and fleets by name. Normal shows objects by the names the game uses and counts fleets as hostile, neutral and friendly. Vague only says whether something can still be salvaged, and how many fleets there are.
Show fleets: on by default.
Gray out found objects: on by default.
Active scan: on by default. Scan cost: volatiles, transplutonics or nothing, and how many.
Planet survey: what the scan does to the planets: Preliminary (default), Full or None.

What Was Wrong With the Original
It ate your frame rate. Every frame it scanned the whole star system, then rescanned it again for every match, only to decide the ability could not be used. In a busy system that was about 7% of every frame on the campaign map. Now the list is only built when you hover the ability.
The list flickered - Now it's normal A random roll (70%) on every frame decided whether faint objects counted, so the same system could show a list one frame and "No objects in range" the next, causing hyper-rapid flickering, which was pretty much a bug stemming from an intended feature. I removed that - Now it always shows everything.
The list was full of junk. Stellar mirrors, fusion lamps, every colony's orbital station, battlestation and star fortress, and What We Left Behind's anti-asteroid satellites (about 20 around a single planet). Now those are left out, repeats are grouped and found objects are gray.
In hyperspace it listed all of hyperspace. Now it works only inside star systems.

Compatibility
Replaces Objects Analysis: turn that mod off. With both on, the game stops at start and tells you.
Same ability, so it keeps its place on your ability bar.
Safe to add to or remove from a game in progress.

Credits
Harpuea made the original Objects Analysis.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
Text (readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
Icons: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)

License
My code in this mod is under the CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with it, without giving any credit to anyone. The ability itself is Harpuea's design from Objects Analysis.

Version log
1.3.1
Added the forum topic link for Version Checker.

1.3.0
New LunaLib setting Planet survey (Preliminary by default): the active scan also surveys every planet in the star system. Preliminary gives each planet a preliminary survey, Full surveys each one fully (survey missions for it complete, but no survey data to sell), None leaves planets alone.

1.2.0
New: Active scan (LunaLib setting, on by default). Click the ability inside a star system: the fleet stops for about 5 seconds and is easier to see, then every object in the system is discovered as if you had flown up to it: named on the map, with the Discovered message and experience. Each scan costs 5 volatiles by default (setting: volatiles, transplutonics or nothing, and the amount). 1 day cooldown.
The list no longer flickers: it always shows everything, without the original's random skip.
The list no longer shows stellar mirrors and shades, fusion lamps, colony stations (orbital stations, battlestations, star fortresses and station colonies), or What We Left Behind's anti-asteroid satellites. Gates stay.
Repeats are grouped: "Debris Field x4".
New setting Gray out found objects (on by default): objects you have already found show in gray.
Works only inside star systems: no list and no scan in hyperspace.

1.1.0
New LunaLib setting Detail (Precise by default). Precise shows derelict ships by name and class, such as "ISS Hamatsu, Legion-class Carrier". Normal shows objects as before. Vague only says whether something in the system can still be salvaged.
New LunaLib setting Show fleets (on by default): the tooltip also lists the fleets in the system. Precise names each fleet, Normal counts hostile, neutral and friendly fleets, Vague gives one total. In hyperspace only fleets within one map grid cell count.
LunaLib is optional: without it the defaults apply.

1.0.0
First release: the Objects Analysis ability from Harpuea's Objects Analysis 002, without its frame rate cost. The ability bar no longer scans the whole star system every frame. The object list is built only when you hover the ability.
The list no longer starts each object name with a stray comma.
